24001.story: As of Oct 16, cash rent in Allegany County runs $28 an acre for 2026, the lowest of 21 in Maryland, against a state median of $117. That rent was $24 in 2016, up 19.1% over ten years. The census value of land and buildings came to $6,375 an acre in 2022, up 14.0% from $5,592 in 2017, and sits 2nd lowest of 23 against a state median of $9,250. Corn here has a median yield of 121.2 bu an acre over 10 years from 2008 to 2019.

24003.story: As of Oct 16, cropland rent in Anne Arundel County ran $66 an acre in 2026, 6th lowest of 21 in Maryland against a state median of $117. The census value of land and buildings tells a different story. It was $12,289 an acre in 2022, 3rd highest of 23, up 19.2% from $10,312 in 2017. Corn yields sit near the middle, with a 14-yr trend of 156.5 bu and 176.8 bu in 2025.

24005.story: As of Oct 16, cash rent in Baltimore County runs $156 an acre for 2026, up 108.0% from $75 in 2016 and 4th highest of 21 in Maryland. The census value of land and buildings was $13,587 an acre in 2022, down 8.4% from $14,825 in 2017, and still highest of 23 in the state. In 2022, 44% of the county's farmland was rented.

24011.story: As of Oct 16, cash rent in Caroline County runs $140 an acre for 2026. That is up 27.3% from $110 in 2016 and ranks 5th highest of 21 in Maryland. The census value of land and buildings was $9,891 an acre in 2022, up 38.8% from $7,126 in 2017. Corn made 132.9 bu in 2024, well under the county median of 157.1 bu for 2008 through 2024.

24013.story: As of Oct 16, cash rent in Carroll County runs $132 an acre for 2024, up 50.0% from $88 in 2014. The 2022 census value of land and buildings came to $10,420 an acre, up 27.4% from 2017, and that sits 9th highest of 23 against a state median of $9,250. Corn trends at 155.9 bu, 7th lowest of 16 in the state, though 2025 came in at 173.3 bu.

24015.story: As of Oct 16, cash rent in Cecil County runs $131 an acre for 2026, up 39.4% from $94 in 2016, and 7th highest of 21 in Maryland against a state median of $117. The census value of land and buildings came in at $10,443 an acre in 2022, up 30.3% from $8,017 in 2017. Corn holds up well here, with a 14-yr trend of 186.1 bu that sits 2nd highest of 16 in the state, and 44% of the farmland was rented in 2022.

24019.story: As of Oct 16, cash rent in Dorchester County runs $117 an acre for 2026, up 9.3% from $107 in 2016 and right at the state median, 11th lowest of 21. The census value of land and buildings was $7,614 an acre in 2022, up 34.1% from $5,676 in 2017, and that ranks 3rd lowest of 23 against a state median of $9,250. Corn made 158.3 bu in 2024, under the 2020-24 average of 168.4 bu.

24023.story: As of Oct 16, cropland rent in Garrett County ran $45 an acre in 2026, up 36.9% from $33 in 2016, and still 3rd lowest of 21 against a state median of $117. The census value of land and buildings came to $5,541 an acre in 2022, up 21.5% from 2017 and the lowest of 23 in Maryland. Corn trends at 122.7 bu, lowest of 16 counties, with 128.2 bu last year.

24027.story: As of Oct 16, the census value of land and buildings in Howard County was $12,622 an acre in 2022, up 37.9% from $9,156 in 2017. That puts it 2nd highest of 23 in Maryland, against a state median of $9,250. Corn does well here too, with a trend yield of 193.0 bu projected for 2026, highest of 16, and 199.5 bu in 2025. Cash rent was $73 an acre in 2017.

24029.story: As of Oct 16, Kent County cash rent was $191 an acre in 2026, highest of 21 in Maryland against a state median of $117. That is up 69.0% from $113 in 2016. The census value of land and buildings was $7,782 an acre in 2022, up 17.7% from 2017 but 5th lowest of 23 against a state median of $9,250. Corn made 193.5 bu in 2025, well over the 18 year median of 164.1 bu.

24031.story: As of Oct 14, cropland rent in Montgomery County runs $111 an acre for 2026, up 76.2% from $63 in 2016 and 9th lowest of 21 in Maryland against a state median of $117. The census value of land and buildings was $10,739 an acre in 2022, up 30.8% from $8,213 in 2017 and 7th highest of 23. The corn trend sits at 173.5 bu, 4th highest of 16, and 56% of the farmland was rented in 2022.

24033.story: As of Oct 16, cash rent in Prince George's County runs $51 an acre for 2026, 4th lowest of 21 in Maryland against a state median of $117. The census value of land and buildings was $9,684 an acre in 2022, up 19.1% from $8,132 in 2017, and sits 11th highest of 23. Corn trends at 147.9 bu, 6th lowest of 16 in the state, and 56% of farmland was rented in 2022.

24035.story: As of Oct 16, cash rent in Queen Anne's County runs $177 an acre for 2026, up 30.1% from $136 in 2016 and 2nd highest of 21 in Maryland against a state median of $117. The census value of land and buildings was $8,163 an acre in 2022, up 11.2% from 2017, which is 8th lowest of 23 in the state. Corn made 192.1 bu in 2025, well over the 162.2 bu median since 2008.

24037.story: As of Oct 16, cash rent in St. Mary's County runs $53 an acre for 2026, down 3.7% from $55 in 2014 and 5th lowest of 21 in Maryland against a state median of $117. The census value of land and buildings was $8,652 an acre in 2022, down 13.0% from $9,949 in 2017. Corn trends at 162.2 bu for 2026, 8th highest of 16 in the state.

24041.story: As of Oct 16, cash rent in Talbot County runs $136 an acre for 2026, up 25.9% from $108 in 2016. That rent sits 6th highest of 21 in Maryland, where the state median is $117. The census value of land and buildings was $9,250 an acre in 2022, up 31.6% from $7,028 in 2017, and it lands right on the state median at 12th lowest of 23. Corn trends at 166.0 bu for 2026, though 2024 came in at 129.9 bu.

24043.story: As of Oct 16, cash rent in Washington County runs $128 an acre for 2026, up 70.7% from $75 in 2016 and 8th highest of 21 in Maryland. The census value of land and buildings was $8,668 an acre in 2022, up 7.6% from 2017, which works out to 1.5% a year. Corn here trends at 141.5 bu, 4th lowest of 16 in the state, though 2025 came in at 158.0 bu.

24045.story: As of Oct 16, cash rent in Wicomico County was $114 an acre in 2026, up 39.9% from $82 in 2016. That sits 10th lowest of 21 in Maryland, just under the state median of $117. The census value of land and buildings was $7,641 an acre in 2022, up 8.6% from 2017 and 4th lowest of 23. Corn made 136.8 bu in 2025, a touch above the 135.2 bu median for 2008 to 2025.

24047.story: As of Oct 16, cash rent in Worcester County runs $118 an acre for 2026, up 33.3% from $89 in 2016 and 10th highest of 21 in Maryland. The census value of land and buildings was $8,232 an acre in 2022, up 55.3% from $5,300 in 2017, which ranks 9th lowest of 23 against a state median of $9,250.
